response.justification: The candidate is a versatile full-stack/web developer with strong experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, but lacks the core requirement of 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development on Windows. His only C/C++ exposure was a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015. There is no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle experience, and while he worked at RIDE Capital (an investment-focused company), the tech stack there was Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, not C++, so there's no genuine capital markets or fixed income domain-plus-C++ combination.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering background with 15+ years of professional experience
Demonstrated experience with CI/CD, TDD, and Docker in prior roles
Exposure to a fintech/investment company (RIDE Capital) providing some domain familiarity
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (only ~6 months at National Instruments), far short of required 5-10 years
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle database experience
No Windows-platform development experience evident; career is centered on web/Linux/cloud stacks

key_factors.factor: Weak alignment with fixed income/capital markets domain despite fintech adjacency
